name: Mandarin Oriental Al Faisaliah, Riyadh
positioning: Mandarin Oriental hotel in Riyadh, with The Globe restaurant in the golden sphere atop Al Faisaliah Tower
best_for: Travelers who want a Mandarin Oriental base in Riyadh
Guests who want separate spas for ladies and gentlemen
Families who want a suite with two king beds

facts.text: The hotel is Mandarin Oriental Al Faisaliah, Riyadh.
The Globe restaurant is located in the golden sphere that tops Al Faisaliah Tower.
The Globe serves modern European cuisine.
La Brasserie is a contemporary, multi-cuisine restaurant featuring interactive stations.
LPM Restaurant & Café serves French Mediterranean cuisine.
Alain Ducasse Chocolat is a Parisian café and chocolate boutique offering bean-to-bar chocolates.
Mamo Michelangelo serves Italian and Provençal cuisine.
Asir Lounge offers mixology and cigars with a view.
The wellness sanctuary offers separate spas for ladies and gentlemen.
The Ladies Spa has nine treatment rooms.

highlights.text: The Globe has an observation platform inside a giant glass 24 metre diameter sphere.
The Globe is a three-story dome with panoramic views of the city.
The Executive Corner Suite has a private balcony.
The Junior Family Suite has two king beds.
The Men's Health Club has a sauna, steam and cold plunge.
The spa received Saudi Arabia's Best Hotel Spa 2025 from the World Spa Awards.

considerations.text: A minimum spend of SAR 350 per guest applies for dinner at The Globe.
For daily dinner at The Globe, children 12 years old and above are welcomed.
The spa is split into a Ladies Spa and a Men's Health Club.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy commercial area with high traffic.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
